inherited_controls.finding: All five reject() controls of PR3633 owners/independent_literal.py (and of its 14 located copies) are tautological: three are unsatisfiable for every input (irreflexive a<a, a one-element set compared with length 2, a shifted column whose entries 0 and 1 are equal compared with tile(arange(408)), whose entries 0 and 1 differ) and two are the negation of an earlier unconditional gate restated with an off-by-one (z[idx[0]]+1 == expected[0] after z[idx]==expected; dict(H) == profile+{1:1} after dict(H)==profile).  No control calls a gate or any module function ("duplicate helper" builds a shifted helper column but compares it inline with the tile, a copy of half the gate expression, so the gate itself is never exercised), and no gate binds or mutates anything by name, so every control passes unchanged when any gate is deleted or weakened: the controls cannot detect a disabled gate (names tracked syntactically; aliasing excluded by inspection of these files).
